label: TEST: CX-8 rig and local test stack only. Not an owner decision and not a product default.

CAMPAIGNS_PLATFORM_TIME_ZONE.note: The platform time zone campaign windows and the calendar are read in, so J-campaigns-01 can activate and join a TEST campaign. Not an owner decision.

CAMPAIGNS_RECONCILE_AFTER_SECONDS.note: How long after an attempt the reconciler posts an open task reward or pot sweep again under the same key, so J-campaigns-02 sees a reward post once its pot is funded. Not an owner decision.

CAMPAIGNS_ROLLBACK_WINDOW_SECONDS.note: The rollback window a reward record shows in the redemption log (J-campaigns-02 #7). Nothing can be rolled back yet: no reversing recipe exists. Not an owner decision.

CAMPAIGNS_RULE_DEPTH_LIMIT.note: The deepest nesting of AND and OR groups in a campaign rule, so J-campaigns-16 #4 can build, try and save a nested rule. Not an owner decision.

CAMPAIGNS_RULE_SIZE_LIMIT.note: The most groups and conditions in one campaign rule (J-campaigns-16 #4). Not an owner decision.
